Package eu.algites.lib.data.dataobject

Annotation Interface AIaDataObject

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(TYPE) public @interface AIaDataObject
Stable identity and descriptive metadata of a data-object schema.

SchemaId is the unversioned logical identifier, while schemaVersion selects a version of that schema. Neither denotes the published SchemaUrl nor an object instance. Generated mutable contracts carry a complete annotation even when their source read-only interface specifies only partial metadata.

    • dataSourceSchemaUrlField

      String dataSourceSchemaUrlField
      Names the optional JSON/YAML instance-document property receiving schemaUrl(). The name is supplied by the selected source-structure naming convention, not inferred from the Java type or the schema dialect keyword $schema. The empty default disables automatic emission; when configured, the runtime omits absent URL values.
      Returns:
      exact serialized property name, or empty when URL metadata is disabled
      Default:
      ""

    • dataSourceSchemaIdentifierField

      String dataSourceSchemaIdentifierField
      Names the optional instance-document property receiving schemaId(). The logical identifier remains available in this annotation even when the target property is disabled. The corresponding schema-source identifier key must be configured for a nonempty target name; no identifier is derived from the URL.
      Returns:
      serialized logical-identifier property name, or empty to omit it
      Default:
      ""

    • dataSourceSchemaVersionField

      String dataSourceSchemaVersionField
      Names the optional instance-document property receiving schemaVersion(). A nonempty name requires a configured source-schema version key. The empty default suppresses serialization, and the sentinel version -1 is never emitted.
      Returns:
      serialized schema-version property name, or empty to omit it
      Default:
      ""

    • namingConvention

      String namingConvention
      Identifies the naming convention used for the annotated contract's own type name.

      The value is an opaque catalog identifier. Its syntax and versioning policy belong to the owner of the naming catalog, not to this annotation or the generators. Empty indicates a manually authored contract without an explicit naming convention.

      Returns:
      the exact naming convention identifier, or an empty string when unspecified
      Default:
      ""

    • setterInheritancePolicy

      AInFieldSetterInheritancePolicy setterInheritancePolicy
      Declares the inherited setter parameter-type strategy for this data object.

      DEFAULT delegates to the configured generator default. A resolved generated contract records an effective strategy independent of the generating build's environment. A fixed strategy does not prevent Java method inheritance; it prevents unsafe type narrowing in descendants.

      Returns:
      the setter parameter inheritance strategy, or DEFAULT when this declaration leaves the selection to its context
      Default:
      DEFAULT
